sources.verification_scope: 58 functional groups and 44 paired performance runs; see docs/PT-BR-QA.json. No full-story or multiplayer playthrough claim.

evidence_policy: Native screens and NPC interaction. Fixtures prepare save/map/party state only; no injected display messages. Unit tests are not translation evidence.
performance_limits: Two EN and two PT-BR runs per edition in the same stationary overworld scene; 180 warm-up and 360 measured frames. This is not a battle or dialog stress benchmark. Vsync and background load affect timing. Lua heap is not process RAM; no forced collection.

optimization.scope: All 25 released localized profiles: 11 German, 11 PT-BR, Emerald FR/IT/ES.
optimization.verification: Cold/warm equivalence for all 25 caches, every compiled asset plus every effective Gen3 text/rom_text/pokemon/moves/items/trainers/strings registry value. Gen1/2 translated catalogs are included as assets. Manifest file-list order and equivalent tile packing are compared semantically; all 11 Emerald contest title maps must render identical indexed pixels.
optimization.method: Fresh processes, warm caches, same pinned engine and Oldale Town scene; order 1.5.0 / 1.5.1 / 1.5.1 / 1.5.0. 180 warm-up frames and 360 measured frames. Only one QA performance process runs at a time.
optimization.limits: Two runs per version on Apple M3 with VSync and other applications running. Lua heap is sampled without forced collection; peak process RSS includes startup and is a different metric. Results are not a whole-story or worst-case benchmark. The first post-update start rebuilds the cache once. Deferred graphics expand on first use, so memory savings depend on visited screens.
